explain: Incremental UTF-8 decoding preserves a character split across transport chunks. Event framing must still buffer until the full SSE event delimiter arrives.
steps: Split bytes inside a multibyte character. || Decode with retained state and join the pieces before parsing the event.
name: utf8-framing

explain: SSE separates fields by lines and dispatches a complete event after a blank line. Multiple data lines form one event payload joined by newline.
steps: Read the event's id and data fields. || Join data lines only after the fixture reaches its terminating blank line.
name: sse-frame

explain: Fetch streaming supports request headers and cancellation when standard EventSource is unsuitable for the application's authentication or POST contract.
steps: Attach the runtime credential and AbortSignal without embedding a real secret. || Check HTTP success before passing the byte stream to an incremental parser.
expect: With a compatible authenticated endpoint, returns a ReadableStream or rejects on HTTP failure.
limit: Browser integration sketch requiring your endpoint and safe credential handling; no live request is made during verification.
name: fetch-stream-choice

explain: Ordered event identities let a reconnect resume without appending repeated text. Expired retention requires an explicit snapshot or resume failure.
steps: Keep the last applied sequence number. || Apply only later events and advance the checkpoint after each accepted event.
name: replay-events

explain: Application writes can still be buffered by proxies or clients. A deployment checklist needs actual stream timing as well as heartbeat configuration.
steps: Record buffering and idle-timeout assumptions separately. || Flag the fixture whose proxy buffering prevents prompt delivery.
name: proxy-stream

explain: Stream closure without a terminal completion event leaves partial output incomplete. An explicit failure event also must not be displayed as successful completion.
steps: Track terminal events independently from accumulated text. || Mark the stream interrupted when no declared terminal outcome arrived.
name: terminal-stream

explain: Server-to-client progress can use a unidirectional event stream while cancellation remains a separate authenticated HTTP operation. Duplex transport is not required merely to show progress.
steps: Separate the progress subscription from the mutation endpoint. || Inspect the operation methods rather than coupling task lifetime to one connection.
name: sse-purpose

explain: A framing regression test feeds the same UTF-8 fixture at every possible byte split. It checks the decoding boundary deterministically without a real network.
steps: Recreate the incremental decoder for each split point. || Assert identical decoded text for all byte partitions.
name: stream-partition-test
